question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

A _________ is a female horse.
solution:
The correct answer is "mare."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **"Mare"** refers to a female horse. (घोड़ी)
 
• Female horses, both young and adult, are commonly referred to as** "mares." **
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence: *A **mare**__ is a female horse.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Vixen: **a female fox.
 
• **Doe: **a female deer.
 
• **Rooster: **a male domestic fowl; a cock.
